Enchant: This Aura can be attached only to the kind of thing it names, such as a creature or a land. If that thing leaves, the Aura is put into its owner's graveyard.
Treasure: Create a Treasure token. It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color."
Protection: Protection from a quality, such as a color: this can't be blocked, targeted, dealt damage, enchanted or equipped by anything with that quality.
Conjure: Create the named card from outside the game and put it where the effect says. Only on Arena.
Food: Create a Food token. It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life."
Double: Make a number twice what it was by adding that much again: double a creature's power and it gets +X/+0, where X is its power.
Seek: Put a card at random from your library that fits the description into your hand. Only on Arena.
Typecycling: N, Discard this card: Search your library for a card of the named type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Affinity: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each permanent of the named kind you control, such as artifacts.
Amass: Put N +1/+1 counters on an Army you control. If you don't control one, first create a 0/0 Army creature token of the named type.
Manifest: Put the top card of your library onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.
Partner with: When this enters, target player may search their library for the named partner, reveal it, put it into their hand, then shuffle. The two can be your commanders together.
Role token: Create a Role token: an Aura that gives the creature it enchants an ability. If a creature has more than one Role from the same player, the older ones go to the graveyard.
Draft from a spellbook: Look at three random cards from this card's spellbook and put one of them into your hand. Only on Arena.
Max speed: This works only while your speed is 4. Your speed starts at 0 and goes up by 1, once each turn, when an opponent loses life during your turn.
Exhaust: Activate each exhaust ability only once.
Exert: An exerted creature won't untap during your next untap step.
Escape: You may cast this card from your graveyard for its escape cost, which includes exiling other cards from your graveyard.
Splice: As you cast a spell of the named type, you may reveal this card from your hand and pay its splice cost to add its rules text to that spell.
Clash: Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts it on the top or the bottom. A player whose card has the higher mana value wins.
Behold: To behold something, choose one you control or reveal one from your hand.
Assemble: Put the top card of your Contraption deck onto the battlefield, on one of your sprockets.
Craft: Exile this and the listed materials from among things you control and cards in your graveyard, then return it transformed. Craft only as a sorcery.
Hexproof from: This can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control that have the named quality.
Specialize: Pay the cost and discard a card to turn this into its version for that card's color. Specialize only as a sorcery. Only on Arena.
Boast: Activate a boast ability only if this creature attacked this turn, and only once each turn.
Solved: Abilities marked Solved work once this Case is solved, which happens at your end step if its To solve condition is met.
For Mirrodin!: When this Equipment enters, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token, then attach this to it.
Detain: Until your next turn, the detained permanent can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated.
Airbend: Exile the permanent. For as long as it remains exiled, its owner may cast it for {2} rather than its mana cost.
Forecast: Activate a forecast ability only during your upkeep and only once each turn, by revealing this card from your hand.
Companion: If your starting deck meets this card's condition, it can be your companion: once a game, pay {3} as a sorcery to put it from outside the game into your hand.
Champion: When this enters, sacrifice it unless you exile another creature of the named kind you control. When this leaves, that card returns to the battlefield.
Cloak: Put the card onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.
Heist: Look at three random nonland cards from an opponent's library and exile one face down. You may cast it while it stays exiled, spending mana as though it were any color. Only on Arena.
Meld: When you own and control both halves of a meld pair, exile them and put them onto the battlefield together as one oversized card.
Triple: Make a number three times what it was by adding twice as much again.
Roll to Visit Your Attractions: Roll a six-sided die. Each Attraction you control with that number lit up is visited, and its visit ability happens.
Vote: Each player, starting with you, votes for one of the choices. The choice with the most votes happens.
Untap: Turn a tapped permanent upright, so it can be used again.
Tap: Turn a permanent sideways to show it has been used. A tapped creature can't attack or block, and a tapped permanent's {T} abilities can't be activated.
Shuffle: Put the cards of a library into a random order.
Set in motion: Move the top card of your scheme deck off it and turn it face up. From Archenemy.
Sacrifice: Put a permanent you control into its owner's graveyard. Indestructible doesn't stop it.
Reveal: Show a card to every player.
Play: Play a land, or cast a spell.
Planeswalk: Turn the current plane or phenomenon away and turn over the next card of the planar deck. From Planechase.
Exile: Put the card into exile, a zone outside the game. It doesn't come back unless an effect says so.
Exchange: Swap the two things named, such as control of two permanents or two life totals.
Discard: Put a card from your hand into your graveyard.
Destroy: Put the permanent into its owner's graveyard. Indestructible stops this.
Create: Put a new token onto the battlefield.
Counter: Cancel a spell or ability on the stack. A countered spell does nothing and goes to its owner's graveyard.
Cast: Put a spell on the stack from where it is and pay its costs.
Attach: Put an Aura, Equipment or Fortification onto another object, so that it affects that object.
Activate: Pay an ability's cost, what comes before the colon, to put the ability on the stack.
Abandon: Turn an ongoing scheme face down and put it on the bottom of your scheme deck. From Archenemy.
Poisonous: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player gets N poison counters.
Friends forever: You can have two commanders if both have friends forever.
Absorb: If a source would deal damage to this creature, prevent N of that damage.
Transform: Turn this double-faced card over to its other face.
Landwalk: This creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a land of the named type, as swampwalk or forestwalk.
Scry: Look at the top N cards of your library. Put any number of them on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.
